access: dispar_app read-only; SHOW/SELECT; system.tables unavailable QUERY_CACHE_USED_WITH_SYSTEM_TABLE; no production mutation

sql: SHOW TABLES FROM lake FORMAT JSONEachRow
SHOW TABLES FROM silver FORMAT JSONEachRow
SHOW CREATE TABLE silver.<nama> FORMAT JSONEachRow
SHOW TABLES FROM serving FORMAT JSONEachRow
inventory.method: Count namespaces from SHOW TABLES. Bronze data = bronze_sdi + bronze_file + bronze_sec, exclude six metadata objects. Silver VIEW/TABLE determined by SHOW CREATE for each object. Operational serving exclude *_baru.

marts.sql: SELECT 'mart_wisman' AS mart,count() AS n FROM serving.mart_wisman UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_kunjungan_dtw',count() FROM serving.mart_kunjungan_dtw UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_gci_readiness',count() FROM serving.mart_gci_readiness UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_event',count() FROM serving.mart_event UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_kuliner',count() FROM serving.mart_kuliner UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_atlas',count() FROM serving.mart_atlas UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_hotel_scraped_booking',count() FROM serving.mart_hotel_scraped_booking FORMAT JSONEachRow

quality_september_last.sql: SELECT verdict,count() AS n FROM _silver_meta.quality WHERE dibuat_pada >= toDateTime('2026-09-29 17:00:00','UTC') AND dibuat_pada < toDateTime('2026-09-30 17:00:00','UTC') GROUP BY verdict FORMAT JSONEachRow

quality_latest.sql: SELECT toDate(dibuat_pada) AS tanggal,verdict,count() AS n FROM _silver_meta.quality WHERE dibuat_pada >= '2026-09-29' GROUP BY tanggal,verdict ORDER BY tanggal,verdict FORMAT JSONEachRow

quality_september_cumulative.sql: SELECT verdict,count() AS n,min(dibuat_pada) AS awal,max(dibuat_pada) AS akhir FROM _silver_meta.quality WHERE dibuat_pada >= toDateTime('2026-08-31 17:00:00','UTC') AND dibuat_pada < toDateTime('2026-09-30 17:00:00','UTC') GROUP BY verdict FORMAT JSONEachRow

rowcount_history.sql: SELECT count() AS n,uniqExact(tabel) AS tabel,min(dibuat_pada) AS awal,max(dibuat_pada) AS akhir FROM _silver_meta.rowcount_history WHERE dibuat_pada >= toDateTime('2026-08-31 17:00:00','UTC') AND dibuat_pada < toDateTime('2026-09-30 17:00:00','UTC') FORMAT JSONEachRow

quarantine.sql: SELECT count() AS n,min(dibuat_pada) AS awal,max(dibuat_pada) AS akhir FROM _silver_meta.karantina FORMAT JSONEachRow
quarantine.sample_sql: SELECT alasan,uniqExact(tabel) AS tabel,sum(jumlah) AS nilai_gagal FROM _silver_meta.karantina WHERE alasan IN ('jumlah (angka) gagal konversi','lon (angka) gagal konversi','lat (angka) gagal konversi','jumlah_ulasan (angka) gagal konversi','rating (angka) gagal konversi') GROUP BY alasan FORMAT JSONEachRow
quarantine.warning: Groups of conversion failures are not counts of unique people or unique source rows. Do not claim blanket exclusion from Gold: this table stores conversion findings.

indicators.label: Wisman Jakarta 2025
indicators.sql: SELECT toYear(periode_data) AS tahun,count() AS baris,min(periode_data) AS awal,max(periode_data) AS akhir,sum(jumlah_kunjungan) AS jumlah FROM silver.wisman_jakarta_per_bulan GROUP BY tahun ORDER BY tahun FORMAT JSONEachRow

indicators.label: Perjalanan wisnus menurut kota tujuan DKI
indicators.sql: SELECT tahun,min(bulan) AS bulan_awal,max(bulan) AS bulan_akhir,count() AS baris,uniqExact(kota_tujuan) AS kota,sum(jumlah_perjalanan) AS jumlah FROM silver.wisnus_perjalanan_per_kota_tujuan GROUP BY tahun ORDER BY tahun FORMAT JSONEachRow

indicators.label: Tenaga kerja ekonomi kreatif DKI 2024
indicators.sql: SELECT tahun,provinsi,jenis_kelamin,jumlah_tenaga_kerja FROM silver.tenaga_kerja_ekraf_per_provinsi WHERE tahun=2024 AND kode_wilayah=31 AND jenis_kelamin='Total' FORMAT JSONEachRow
